Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://www.twilio.com/docs/authy/twilioauth-sdk/quickstart/integrating-sdk-using-your-own-backend

Painpoint: agents frequently need compact, citation-ready context for SMS/voice/API docs agents need: integrating sdk using your own backend

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py context-budget . --json --strict
```

Machine files:
- material-manifest.json
- proof-receipt.json

Rules:
